name: Rotavator/Thresher Machine Equipment Assistance Scheme
benefit: - Financial assistance to farmers to purchase a rotavator (6 feet) or a thresher machine.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a farmer. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribes (ST) category. 1. The applicant should belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. 1. The applicant should be a resident of tribal or forest areas of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a farmer dependent on agriculture as the main source of livelihood. 1. The applicant should intend to use the machinery for self-employment and agricultural purposes.
